name: Jasper

holders.name: Ryan Craig
holders.note: Page gives term 4/1/2026 - 12/31/2027. Chosen by Republican precinct caucus in Jan 2026 to finish Dean Vonderheide's term; took office April 1, 2026 (raw/jasper-in/craig-article.html).

holders.name: John Schroeder
holders.note: Council page numbers districts 2 to 6; there is no District 1 (see notes)

holders.name: Phil Mundy
holders.note: Also President Pro-Tempore. He applied for the mayor caucus and lost to Craig; the GIS layer was edited for the At Large rows in July 2026 (see map notes).
